title: ArcCivs founding hall priority after physical bootstrap; before-source assessment
assumptions: BEFORE main change, LAB only: PHYSICAL Auto1 has active hut/forester/quarry/farm but waits for an unplaced warehouse; Auto3 lacks an admissible farm. Published nextGoal postpones the existing SITE hall behind both. Public13-case reproduction has2expectedgoal failures and11passing controls; this is domain scheduling evidence, not native construction proof.

Proposed policy: after active HUT+FORESTER+QUARRY, finish the existing PHYSICAL SITE hall before adding FARM/WAREHOUSE. Existing accepted ordinary sites/queue keep priority. Legacy stock order, prices and shortages remain unchanged. No new site, layout, stock or completion is synthesized.

PHYSICAL goal.cost and missing are zero domain scheduler placeholders, not a funding proof. Existing ordinary construction bill, carried/local/incoming/exportable supply deductions, per-row debit, durability and inventory journal remain authoritative. Auto supplies already support this HUT local buffer without a warehouse.

Gross backend AutoSupply envelope is unchanged:1accepted receipt/s with at most8material kinds and64units/material (512native item units), shared across all towns. Low/base/high sensitivity uses0.25/1/4active hours/day for one administrator/backend,900/3600/14400possible receipts, not measured activity or a guarantee. Native_item_units is a gross service count, not an interchangeable valuation of species.

Existing supply upper bound stays equal before/after, but earlier eligible Hall orders can consume a different material mix and enable more native topups/real production versus a geometrically blocked town. Do not interpret the zero cap delta as zero realized item effect. The retained Hall plan has25228schematic and2108terrain cells; cells are not the payable item bill (AIR/recipes/materials vary). Exact native bill is computed by existing construction code, not invented here.

Completing a hall can open the existing physical-emerald trade earlier. Treasury is not seeded; goods and EMERALDs transfer through the existing journal at unchanged bid/ask rates and stock reserves. No new currency provider, grant, refund, construction credit or trade fixture is introduced. Vault,tokens,EMERALD mint and playerXP remain separately0direct change.

Current EconomyShopGUI SELL/AutoSell and the planned SELL-to-contract transition remain separate. No item-to-money quote or earnings is assumed; actual long-run throughput, item mix and native acceptance remain unmeasured. Source/package/deploy/native evidence will be recorded separately.
